definitions: For fixed n and finite Y, take a contiguous natural-source-order partition 2=M_0<M_1<...<M_J=Y and B_{n,j}=sum_{m=M_{j-1}+1}^{M_j} a_{n,m}.
Define mean mu_n=J^{-1} sum_j B_{n,j}, centered blocks C_{n,j}=B_{n,j}-mu_n, and centered energy V_n=(sum_j |C_{n,j}|^2)^{1/2}.
Define raw p-block norm E_{n,p}=(sum_j |B_{n,j}|^p)^{1/p} for 1<=p<infinity, with the usual max norm for p=infinity.
proposed_exact_claims: sum_j C_{n,j}=0 and R_n(Y)=sum_j B_{n,j}=J mu_n.

Any statistic H_n that is a function only of the centered vector C_n has no direct contribution to R_n(Y) through the sum functional; a Li/endpoint implication from H_n therefore needs an additional target-domain theorem coupling the discarded mean to C_n or separate control of mu_n, plus the exact complement.

For every p in [1,infinity], |R_n(Y)| <= J^(1-1/p) E_{n,p}, with 1/p=0 at p=infinity. Thus an uncentered block-norm certificate strong enough at the relevant scale directly controls the prefix endpoint and must undergo the same obligation-strength audit rather than being presumed local.
falsifiers: Find a finite block vector for which sum(C) != 0 or R != J*mu.
Find p>=1 and a finite block vector violating Holder's bound on the sum.
Show that the actual fixed-zeta arithmetic supplies a proved all-index mean-versus-centered-fluctuation coupling strong enough for the Li consumer; if so, the gluing diagnosis must be revised.
Reject any target-domain strictness claim that relies only on arbitrary ambient block vectors with shifted common level.
nonclaims: No target-domain arithmetic DifferenceWitness is asserted.
No theorem states that centered fluctuations are independent of the arithmetic mean in the actual zeta sequence.
No Li coefficient positivity, zero-free theorem, or RH theorem is claimed.
expected_discriminator: If exact algebra verifies, the cutoff-block family splits into a level-sensitive branch that risks endpoint-control collapse and a centered level-invariant branch that leaves an explicit mean/gluing interface. If target-domain coupling is not source-bound, rotate representation.
